decisions.reason: Premium customer support is very close to the firm's core hosting and service model, likely inexpensive to continue as an option, and still strengthens its agency-focused differentiation.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's platform and in-house development capabilities, so its strategic fit and option value remain high relative to its carrying cost.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively distant from the core hosting business, and after several years its uncertainty is likely resolved enough that limited strategic fit outweighs the value of keeping it open.
Scalable hosting for agencies sits at the center of the firm's customer base and growth path, so management would likely retain it as a strong, still-promising extension of the established business.
